services.name: Trainer
services.tooltip: Background process at /Users/cashconway/OpenSuperSampling trains the v6.1 SRCNN model on the 3080 Ti and emits metrics.json every step.

services.name: Watcher
services.tooltip: Loop in scripts/watch_and_publish.sh that rebuilds data.json from runs/ and pushes to R2 every ~30s.

services.name: CF Worker
services.tooltip: Cloudflare Worker at upload.opensupersampling.com that auths uploads from the trainer and writes them into the R2 bucket.

services.name: R2 origin
services.tooltip: Cloudflare R2 bucket served at opensupersampling.com - the CDN origin every visitor hits.

services.name: DNS
services.tooltip: Public DNS resolution for opensupersampling.com via Cloudflare nameservers.
